platformAdminWelcome.title: You are the platform administrator
platformAdminWelcome.body: Signing in made you this deployment's platform administrator. You hold every capability here, including the org, role, and user administration surfaces — nobody else can claim it now.
platformAdminWelcome.inviteStep1: Open Team from the navigation bar.
platformAdminWelcome.inviteStep2: Create an invitation for the organization and role you want the person to hold.
platformAdminWelcome.inviteStep3: Send them the invite link. Signing in through it joins them to that organization with that role — they never become a platform administrator.
